opening: I get a tingling pain in the sole of my right foot.

I've had type 2 diabetes for 8 years.

opening.text: I've been getting a tingling pain in the sole of my right foot for the last 6 weeks. My right calf cramps up, though the pain goes away after a few minutes of rest. I've had type 2 diabetes for 8 years, and I smoke two packs a day, which I've done for 34 years.
